snippet.title: Age of Damnation Trailer
snippet.description:
Age of Damnation — a fantasy medieval strategy with a top-down view. By day, you explore the forest and build your settlement. By night, you defend against waves of monsters born from damnation mist.
Gather resources, develop your settlement, research technologies, build defenses, destroy monsters.
Now in Steam!
